title: Line-module effectivity on fixed polarized scheme charts
statement: Let $D$ be a polarized descent datum [def-trf-polarized-scheme-etale-descent-datum] for schemes $S$, $U_i$, $X_i$, maps $u_i:U_i\to S$, $f_i:X_i\to U_i$, and invertible modules $L_i$, indexed by a set $I$ in an arbitrary universe. Fix a scheme $Y$, a map $g:Y\to S$, and isomorphisms $e_i:Y\times_SU_i\simeq X_i$ over $U_i$. Suppose their chart maps $q_i=\operatorname{pr}_Y e_i^{-1}$ induce precisely the given transitions: $q_i p_i=q_j p_j\theta_{ij}$ on every overlap. There exist an ordinary invertible module $M$ on this fixed $Y$ and isomorphisms $c_i:\operatorname{pr}_Y^*M\simeq e_i^*L_i$ such that the candidate pair $(Y,M)$ with these labelled charts realizes $D$. In particular its line transitions equal exactly $\lambda_{ij}$ under the stipulated canonical tensor composition and equality comparisons. No scheme effectivity assertion is made.

proof.text: The maps e_i^{-1} followed by the first projections form an etale covering of Y: transport the base change of the given covering U_i of S along the isomorphisms e_i. The theta equation and pullback uniqueness identify its double overlaps with the specified polarizedOverlap, with second projection theta_ij followed by p_j. Dependencies: [lem-trf-fppf-covering-base-change], [def-trf-polarized-scheme-etale-descent-datum].

proof.text: Transport lambda to this covering's module descent data. Its diagonal and cocycle conditions follow from D.lambda_identity and D.lambda_cocycle using the canonical tensor-pullback composition and identity comparisons. Invertibility makes each component quasi-coherent. Fpqc effectivity (Descent Tag 023T) supplies M and the compatible local module isomorphisms. Finite local freeness of rank one descends, so M is invertible (Tag 05VG). Dependencies: [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-finer-than-etale], [lem-pc-fpqc-descent].

proof.text: Pull these local identifications along e_i to obtain c on Y times_S U_i. The unit and associativity of the canonical comparisons identify their direct chart expressions polarizedChartLine with the identifications just descended. Their overlap equation is precisely the lambda field of IsPolarizedDescentRealization. The theta field is the assumed htheta. The empty scheme and empty cover satisfy the same sheaf equalizers and require no nonemptiness assumption. Dependencies: [lem-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-associativity], [def-trf-polarized-scheme-etale-descent-datum].

theorem exists_polarizedModule_on_schemeCharts
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type v} {U : I → Scheme.{u}}
    {uMap : ∀ i, U i ⟶ S} {X : I → Scheme.{u}} {f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ U i}
    {L : ∀ i, (X i).Modules} {hL : ∀ i, Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible (L i)}
    (D : PolarizedSchemeEtaleDescentDatum S I U uMap X f L hL)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ S) (e : ∀ i, pullback g (uMap i) ≅ X i)
    (he : ∀ i, (e i).hom ≫ f i = pullback.snd g (uMap i))
    (htheta : ∀ i j,
      polarizedOverlapX U uMap X f i j ≫ (e i).inv ≫ pullback.fst g (uMap i) =
        (D.theta i j).hom ≫ polarizedOverlapX U uMap X f j i ≫
          (e j).inv ≫ pullback.fst g (uMap j))
    : ∃ (M : Y.Modules) (hM : Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible M)
        (c : ∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst g (uMap i))).obj M ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (e i).hom).obj (L i)),
      IsPolarizedDescentRealization D
        { Y := Y, g := g, M := M, isInvertible := hM,
          chart := fun i ↦ { schemeIso := e i, over := he i, moduleIso := c i } }
